nodes.description: Pricing.price: current price of Schain creation, written by adjustPrice
Pricing.lastUpdated: timestamp of last price adjustment, set from now
Pricing.totalNodes: cached number of online nodes
Pricing.adjustPrice: permissionless price recalculation using time and load/capacity
block.timestamp / now: miner-influenced time source used for deadlines and price math
msg.sender: unverified external caller used for ownership and role checks
SkaleManager.getBounty: pays bounty to node validator after monitor metrics
Address.sendValue: forwards native value to an arbitrary payable recipient
Low level call: recipient.call{value: amount}("") with all gas forwarded
SkaleDKG.broadcast: node submits verification vector and secret key contributions
SkaleDKG.complaint: time-dependent complaint/slashing decision
SkaleDKG.response: node responds to a complaint and triggers slashing
Schains.addSchain: creates a Schain from decoded user data and deposit
Schains.deleteSchain: removes a Schain and returns node space
Punisher._locked: holder => locked slashed token amount
Punisher.forgive: admin-only reduction of locked amount
OwnableUpgradeSafe._owner: privileged owner address
OwnableUpgradeSafe.transferOwnership: onlyOwner ownership transfer
Permissions.initialize: grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to msg.sender and sets ContractManager
contractManagerAddress input of Permissions.initialize
ValidatorService.registerValidator: registers msg.sender as a validator
ValidatorService.numberOfValidators: monotonically incremented counter
DelegationController.delegate: creates a delegation proposal for msg.sender
DelegationController.delegations: array of all delegation records
DelegationController.confiscate: slashes delegated stake for a validator
Distributor.withdrawBounty: transfers earned bounty after lockup
Bounty.getBounty: computes and reduces node bounty from stage pool
Bounty._stagePool: remaining token pool for current stage
local variable bounty computed in Bounty.getBounty
Nodes.createNode: appends a node record for a validator address
Nodes.nodes: array of all node records
SkaleManager.createNode: permissionless node creation entrypoint
nodeIndex input selecting the node in Bounty.getBounty
ecrecover precompile used to derive a signer address from a signature
ECDSA.recover: signature validation and signer recovery
Inline assembly extcodehash(account) for contract existence check
Address.isContract: returns whether an address has code
Inline assembly staticcall to precompiled contracts (modexp/pairing/scalar mul)
Precompiled.bigModExp: modular exponentiation via precompile 0x05
SchainsInternal.initializeSchain: writes schain record with block.timestamp
SchainsInternal.schains: schainId => Schain struct mapping
validatorId input of DelegationController.confiscate
amount input of DelegationController.confiscate
SkaleManager.nodeExit: node exit flow gated by msg.sender/validator ownership

edges.reason: adjustPrice recomputes and writes the price state variable using multiplication/division on load and capacity
adjustPrice stores block.timestamp into lastUpdated
adjustPrice calls checkAllNodes which refreshes totalNodes
cooldown check and timeSkipped depend on block.timestamp, making execution miner-influenced
complaint win/lose decision is driven by block.timestamp deadlines
bounty stage pool sizing and reward periods depend on now
schain startDate is set from block.timestamp
msg.sender receives DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE during initialization
validator registration binds the validator address to msg.sender
node is created on behalf of msg.sender without owner restriction
onlyAdmin modifier validates msg.sender against admin roles
nodeExit derives permission from msg.sender node/validator ownership
sendValue transfers value through a low-level call that forwards all gas to an untrusted recipient
createNode pushes a new node struct into the nodes array
SkaleManager.createNode delegates node creation to Nodes.createNode
recover uses ecrecover as the identity/authorization primitive
isContract relies on inline assembly extcodehash to test code presence
bigModExp performs a raw staticcall into precompiled contract 0x05
confiscate reduces delegation values through fractional coefficients
delegate appends a new delegation record to the delegations array
registerValidator increments numberOfValidators
getBounty subtracts the computed bounty from the stage pool
forgive reduces the holder's locked amount
nodeExit mutates node status, finish time and validator node lists
addSchain initializes the schain through SchainsInternal.initializeSchain
deleteSchain removes schain entries from the SchainsInternal mapping
initialize forwards the contractManagerAddress parameter to the ContractManager setter
nodeIndex parameter selects the node used in bounty computation
getBounty stores and reduces the local bounty value before returning
validatorId parameter selects which validator stake is slashed
amount parameter is used to reduce the delegated value
initializeSchain writes the schain struct into the schains mapping
SkaleManager.getBounty calls Bounty.getBounty to compute the payout

normalization_plan.reason: One-off initialization parameter that only feeds Permissions.initialize and the ContractManager setter; no standalone identity needed
Temporary value produced, reduced and returned entirely inside Bounty.getBounty; can be folded into the function node
Index parameter only used for node lookups within Bounty.getBounty; merged into the enclosing core function
Slashing target identifier consumed only by confiscate; merged into the core function node
Slashed amount consumed only by confiscate arithmetic; merged into the core function node
